entries.text: You see Petrox, a desert bandit.
entries.source_text: You see Petrox, a desert bandit.

entries.text: Greetings! I am Petrox. I am one of Garl's lead raiders. Who are you?
entries.source_text: Greetings! I am Petrox. I am one of Garl's lead raiders. Who are you?

entries.text: I'm
entries.source_text: I'm

entries.text: . What do you do as a raider?
entries.source_text: . What do you do as a raider?

entries.text: My name is unimportant at the moment. Can you tell me something about your camp?
entries.source_text: My name is unimportant at the moment. Can you tell me something about your camp?

entries.text: Hroo?
entries.source_text: Hroo?

entries.text: As a raider, I get to travel to many parts of the wasteland. In my travels, I get supplies for the camp.

entries.text: In other words, you steal from the people you go to.

entries.text: Hey, that's really great of you. I'm sure that Garl is pleased with you.
entries.source_text: Hey, that's really great of you. I'm sure that Garl is pleased with you.

entries.text: What places have you been to?
entries.source_text: What places have you been to?

entries.text: Well, it's nice that you think that you are so important that you don't need a name to go around here. But, I will at least tell you a little about us. We are the toughest people in the wastelands. No one can stand against us. Not even those wimps from Shady Sands or Junktown.

entries.text: I am sorry, but I don't have time to waste on those who are slow. Good bye.
entries.source_text: I am sorry, but I don't have time to waste on those who are slow. Good bye.

entries.text: We never steal. We just take the extra that others have and redistribute it among our hungry people.

entries.text: That sounds like a really great idea.

entries.text: I've been to many places in the wastelands. The closest places that I've been to are Shady Sands and Junktown. Not much happens in those places, but they are always full of information and supplies.

entries.text: What can you tell me about Junktown?

entries.text: Junktown is a little bit south of here. They have many good women.

entries.text: Junktown is a little bit south of here. They have many good women. Say . . . I can show you around sometime, maybe we can get to know each other better . . . whaddya say?
